title: La Carlota Sy 4 soybean (NSIC Sy 11): Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: La Carlota Sy 4 soybean: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: La Carlota Sy 4 soybean is a grain soybean variety. About 87 days to harvest, 1.8 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits.
excerpt: La Carlota Sy 4 soybean is a grain soybean variety, also sold or known as NSIC Sy 11 or La Carlota soybean. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council in 2018 as NSIC 2018 Sy 11. It takes about 87 days from sowing to harvest, with 1.83 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

La Carlota Sy 4 soybean takes about 87 days from sowing to harvest. That is about the average of the 19 grain soybean varieties with a day count, 84.6 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 1.83 t/ha trails the average of its group, 1.92. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing. Its seller gives about 87 to 91 days.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting.

The pests and diseases that hit soybean fields most often: [bean fly](/pests/bean-fly), [legume pod borer](/pests/legume-pod-borer), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm), [cutworm](/pests/cutworm). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
A hundred seeds weigh about 12.9 grams, so the higher this number, the bigger the seed. The seed coat is cream. The seed holds 37.2 percent crude protein.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: bPI's newer soybean bred for year round planting anywhere in the country. Check these against what farmers near you have seen, because the same variety can do differently from one town to the next.
Where and when to plant La Carlota Sy 4 soybean
Grain soybean goes to feed and food processors, while vegetable soybean, or edamame, is picked green. Pick a variety rated against rust, the main soybean disease here.

items.q: Is NSIC Sy 11 the same as La Carlota Sy 4?
items.a: Yes. NSIC Sy 11 is another name for La Carlota Sy 4, registered as NSIC 2018 Sy 11. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes about 87 days from sowing to harvest. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 1.83 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of La Carlota Sy 4?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
